## Purpose

My culminating experience project focuses on student engagement at Collins College and how it may relate to enrollment and retention.

## Main questions

- What engagement information is available?
- How should enrollment and retention be defined?
- What patterns would be useful to Collins College stakeholders?

The project is still in the planning and data-preparation stage, so this portfolio does not report final results.
